description: What the row is, set by its source. One value per row.

values.label: Advisory
values.definition: A security advisory or alert from a vendor, CERT or government agency.

values.label: Research
values.definition: A research team's post: analysis, findings or a technical write-up.

values.label: Reporting
values.definition: A news outlet's or commentator's report.

values.label: Incident
values.definition: A first-party statement about an incident at the publishing organization.

values.label: KEV entry
values.definition: An entry in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, dated by catalog addition.

values.label: Filing
values.definition: A regulatory filing. No filing source is connected today, so no row carries this value yet.

values.label: Bulletin
values.definition: A vendor security bulletin from a history adapter (for example Microsoft MS98 to MS17).

values.label: Vulnerability note
values.definition: A CERT/CC vulnerability note from a history adapter.

values.label: Change
values.definition: A vendor's product or service change announcement: a release note, a feature launch, a retirement or a deprecation notice. Reserved for the cloud-change sources the revision plan adds; no source carries it yet.

values.label: Lifecycle
values.definition: An end-of-support or release-schedule row from a lifecycle source. Reserved for the end-of-life desk the revision plan adds; no row carries it yet.
